deploybot: 🚀 Starting multi-service fanout deploy
Environment: prod
Tag: v2.14.0
Commit: abc1234de
Targets: runtime, api, console
Strategy: staggered canary -> global
Canary: runtime+api in us-west-2 (5% traffic)
Pinned versions: none (will apply tag)

alex: ack, I triggered the window at 09:15PT. tagging release notes now.

maria: noted. i'll watch api canary metrics. ping me if errors > 2%.

deploybot: runtime: canary started (instance=rt-canary-03)
api: canary started (instance=api-canary-12)
console: queued (waiting for canary pass)

chris: saw a spike in 5xx on api-canary-12 at +2m. logs show 502 from gateway.

maria: adding logs snippet:
```
2026-03-20T16:02:15Z api-canary-12 ERROR upstream response 502 {"path":"/v1/chat"}
```

alex: is it transient? rolling back api canary only or pause whole fanout?

maria: suggest pause fanout. api metric: error rate 3.8% over 1m, latency p95 +200ms. runtime looks stable.

chris: agree pause. we should avoid console rollout until api stable. don't rollback yet — try to repro on canary host.

deploybot: update: fanout paused by @alex — console remains queued. runtime continuing. api canary -> paused (healthcheck failing)

jen: I can repro locally against canary with the same tag. quick fix would be to pin api to v2.13.7 while we patch v2.14.0.

alex: good plan. pin api to v2.13.7 for prod, continue runtime/console after api stable? we need consistent client behavior.

maria: pinning api now. healthchecks will flip once pinned instance pool drains and replaces with v2.13.7.

deploybot: action: pin api -> v2.13.7 (requested by @alex)
Status: pin job started (job_id=pin-8921)

deploybot: api: pin applied on 3/3 nodes, healthchecks passing on 2/3. expected full recovery ~60s.

maria: healthcheck back to normal, error rate < 0.5% for 2m. looks good.

alex: ok resume console and finish remaining runtime buckets. keep monitoring alert thresholds.

deploybot: fanout resuming: console -> start (instance=console-05), runtime -> continuing global rollout

chris: watch for any regressions in client integration tests. I'll run quick smoke now.

jen: leaving a note: will cut v2.14.0-hotfix branch for api regression post-mortem.

deploybot: COMPLETE: multi-service deploy v2.14.0 partial (api pinned to v2.13.7; runtime+console at v2.14.0)
Details: https://deploy.internal/reports/1947654321
If any teams need rollback, reply with /rollback <service> <target_tag>

alex: thanks everyone. filed a post-deploy incident with steps and timeline. :thumbsup:
